summary: A Verge roundup from December 2023 of current deals on wireless earbuds and headphones, organized by brand (Apple, Beats, Sony, Bose, Google, Samsung, Jabra, Sennheiser, UE, Anker, Nothing, Amazon). For each model it gives a short description of strengths and weaknesses, the regular price, the sale price, and which retailers carry the deal. It also links to the site's guides to the best wireless earbuds and noise-canceling headphones.
one_line: The Verge's December 2023 roundup of discounted wireless earbuds and headphones from Apple, Sony, Bose, Google, Samsung, Jabra and others, with prices and retailers.
key_facts: Apple's second-gen AirPods Pro without USB-C cost $189.99 in-store at Micro Center, and $229 ($20 off) at B&H Photo; the USB-C version is $237 at Amazon, Walmart and B&H Photo.
The AirPods Max have an MSRP of $549 and were on sale for $479.99 ($70 off) at Amazon and Best Buy; they lack lossless audio but have the best transparency mode on the list.
The Beats Studio Pro normally cost $349.99 and were $271.15 in blue at Amazon, or $299.99 in other colors at Best Buy and Verizon; they replaced the Beats Studio 3 after six years.
The Sony WH-1000XM5 are the Verge's favorite noise-canceling headphones and cost around $328 ($70 off) at B&H Photo, Best Buy and Target.
The Sony WH-CH720N retail for $149 and were around $98 at Amazon, B&H Photo and Best Buy, with up to 35 hours of playback.
The Sony LinkBuds S weigh just 4.8 grams per bud, support the LDAC codec, and were around $148 (normally $199.99) at Amazon and Target.
The Bose QuietComfort Headphones replaced the QuietComfort 45 and cost $249 ($100 off), while the QuietComfort 45 cost $229; battery life is 24 hours.
The Bose QuietComfort Ultra earbuds cost $279 ($20 off) after recently dropping to $249; they lack multipoint support and a built-in wireless charging case.
The Google Pixel Buds Pro were about $119.99 ($80 off), and the Pixel Buds A-Series were $83.34 against an all-time low of $58.98.
The Sennheiser Momentum Wireless 4 last up to 60 hours per charge and cost $269.89 at Amazon, normally $379.95.
The UE Fits permanently mold to the shape of the ear in 60 seconds, have eight-hour battery life, and cost $149.99 (normally $199) direct from Ultimate Ears.
The Nothing Ear Stick cost $59 ($40 off) from Nothing; the third-gen Amazon Echo Buds cost $34.99 ($15 off), matching their all-time low.
The Jabra Elite 8 Active have an IP68 rating and need no hooks or fins for a secure fit; they cost $149.99 (normally $199.99).
The Anker Soundcore Liberty 3 Pro cost $99.99 at Amazon, regularly $169.99, and support LDAC.
